inlines.v: MALT'-DUST, noun The grains or remains of malt. Malt-dust is an enricher of barren land. MALT'-FLOOR, noun A floor for drying malt. MALT'-HORSE, noun A horse employed in grinding malt; hence, a dull fellow.
